label: The demarcation criterion of the restricted measure doctrine: in the just, unjust, holy and unholy…
paraphrase: The demarcation criterion of the restricted measure doctrine: in the just, unjust, holy and unholy nothing has by nature a being of its own, so what is commonly decided becomes true when and for as long as it is decided; judgements of what is advantageous, by contrast, answer to how things will turn out.
